Good People Should Meet Good People

What happens when you meet the right person at the right time under the right context? We interview entrepreneurs, creatives, and professionals doing great work in their fields and communities who have something to teach us. Every good person should meet the people below.

Episode 2

Bartholomew Jones

From -$700 to Million Dollar Coffee Brand: The Cxffeeblack Story

Scooter talks with Bartholomew Jones about growing Cxffeeblack from a negative $700 starting point into a community-backed coffee business that raised $1 million. Their conversation explores cultural authenticity, Black ownership, and how recurring customer support funds jobs, training, and neighborhood outreach in Memphis.
